_how_to_use: Copy this file to countries/<your_country_id>.json and replace the placeholder values. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the game. See HOW_TO_ADD_A_COUNTRY.md for the full field-by-field guide.
name: Example Republic
subtitle: From counting beans to counting ballots.

deposit.kept_line: Over 1,000 votes! Your €500 deposit is saved.

major_parties.name: Unity Party

leader.name: Max Quibble
leader.persona: A career politician who has never queueed for anything.

major_parties.blurb: Unity: because two of everything was too confusing.

leader.persona: Loves the flag, the mountains, and long pauses before saying 'freedom'.

leader.persona: A root vegetable aristocrat with a monocle and a grudge against mashed politics.
